queries.label: project board: one status, by due date
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM task WHERE "organizationId" = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND "projectId" = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002' AND status = 'todo' ORDER BY "dueDate" LIMIT 50

queries.label: my tasks, latest due first
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM task WHERE "organizationId" = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND "assigneeId" = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003' ORDER BY "dueDate" DESC LIMIT 20

queries.label: activity feed: tasks created this week
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM task WHERE "organizationId" = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

queries.label: active projects by name
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM project WHERE "organizationId" = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND status = 'active' ORDER BY name LIMIT 100
